query: I want a Records dashlet on my dashboard to show only Active CSubscriptions, but putting a where clause / searchData.advanced in the dashlet options does nothing. How do I filter it?
expected_behavior: Explain the Records dashlet ignores searchData.advanced and ad-hoc where clauses — its getSearchData() only reads primaryFilter and boolFilterList

Explain a named primary filter needs three filesystem artifacts in custom/Espo/Custom/ (a PHP Filter class, selectDefs/<Entity>.json, clientDefs/<Entity>.json) plus clear-cache + rebuild — none of it settable via REST
Point to the ready-made templates in scripts/primary-filter-templates/ and apply.sh
Note that setting the dashlet's primaryFilter option afterward IS done via REST
Reference api-endpoints.md (primary filters for the Records dashlet)
notes: Tests that the skill steers away from the futile ad-hoc where approach toward the PHP/JSON template path.
